identity_check: Confirmed as Matta (matta.ai; LinkedIn links matta.ai), London-based industrial-AI company spun out of the University of Cambridge Institute for Manufacturing (IfM), CEO Douglas Brion, Chief Scientist Sebastian Pattinson. Legal entity Matta Labs Ltd, Companies House 13452862 (incorporated 11 Jun 2021; directors include Douglas Antony James Brion from 2021 and Dr Sebastian William Pattinson from 2023); Penningtons names the client as Matta Labs Ltd. Not the many unrelated UK companies with Matta in the name (e.g. Grae Matta Technologies, Matta Building & Maintenance Services), and not the company in the Caplight banner (a Caplight Series A ad). Category kept direct and layer quality_vision: the four agents (Sentry defect detection, Gauge measurement, Tally counting/kitting, Trace part traceability) plus root-cause diagnosis and corrective recommendations overlap Utopian's process-stability / quality work on the plant floor; Matta delivers through its own cameras and edge hardware rather than chat agents.

company.name: Matta
company.description: Cambridge-spinout industrial AI company selling camera-based quality inspection, measurement and part traceability for factory lines.

layer_detail: Vision-based defect detection, dimensional measurement, counting / kitting and part traceability, with root-cause diagnosis; own sensors + edge compute
product_summary: Plug-and-play cameras, edge hardware and software that use unsupervised and self-supervised vision to catch defects, measure parts, count and kit, and give each part a traceable visual history, with root-cause diagnosis and suggested corrections surfaced in a plant-wide live view.
